why: ¶69 says 'our driver pulled up' at the villa, so a driver is already part of the story.
¶69 mentions 'a paddock' lying between the villa and a grey-tiled out-building.

The time (Thursday evening) follows from the story, but the story never says this red-brick villa is Straker's. It only says Straker lived in a small villa about 200 yards from the stables, so the identification is an inference the text does not state.
